name: player_add_scaled_hud_counter_value
description: Player::AddScaledHudCounterValue scales a HUD counter increment by damage-feedback hit count over the primary-gun dispatch count when available, converts through the compiler float-to-int path, and accumulates it.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player/HUD combat-stat source-cluster pass; the original conversion uses compiler _ftol glue.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42a9f0 validates the primaryGunDispatchCount > 0 gate, scale = g_OptCatalog_DamageFeedbackHitCount / primaryGunDispatchCount when active, default scale 1.0 otherwise, multiplication by 1000.0, _ftol conversion, and accumulation into g_Player_HudCounterValue.
The native smoke verifies unscaled accumulation, hit-count/dispatch-count scaled accumulation, and negative scaled increments.
